name: Sunday Cup
blurb: the first rung: a field of club snails, four courses and the marathon — and the opener is a run through the ash

name: Snail Open
blurb: county standard: better snails than you, and they know the courses — the second of them is the stair up the basalt

name: Snail Invitational
blurb: the meeting: the best of the county, and the longest walks between the jumps — and black water where the lilies were

name: Snail GP
blurb: the top of the ladder: everybody here rates in three figures, and the ground goes on for ever — out to a drift over dead country
